answer: Sybil resistance relies on collateralized attestation: an agent must escrow stake before it can verify peers or claim rewards. When two agents attest to contradictory facts, a quorum inspects the proofs and slashes the dishonest side, destroying its bond. A sybil attacker cannot mint free identities: each clone needs separate locked capital and each false claim risks forfeiting it, so farms collapse once fabrication cost exceeds expected payout. Honest agents pool around a verifiable oasis of staked reputation; impostors sink into a lagoon, and leftover identities are pruned like yarrow.
